title: Per-customer bucketized phasing + heatmap (Nov 2026)
content:
Executive summary:
This sheet is a working phasing plan for customer-dedicated GPU reservations for Nov 2026. It groups per-contract reservations into bucketed allocations over a 6-month runway, surfaces per-region concentration, and a simple text heatmap showing where near-term pressure is highest. Purpose: help infra planning, sales handoffs, and SRE runbook pre-allocation (failover regions and contingency).

Key assumptions:
- Allocation unit = 1 x A100-80GB equivalent (logical GPU unit). Mixed instances are normalized to A100-80GB SKU equivalents using internal factor table.
- Customers may request burst capacity; 20% of bucket is kept as contingency unless contract asserts burst SLA.
- Targets reflect expected utilization (p95) under current traffic forecasts; we use a conservative headroom of +15% for month-of ramp.
- Migration windows for large contracts are 4 weeks (prep + dry-run).

Table (rows = per-contract phasing buckets):
Contract ID | Customer | Primary region(s) | Reserved GPUs (units) | Start date | Month 0-1 | Month 2-3 | Month 4-5 | Utilization target (p95) | Contingency bucket | Short notes / action items
RED-0012 | AcmePay | us-west1 | 48 | 2026-11-15 | 12 | 18 | 18 | 72% | 10% (5 units) | Prep network egress; SRE runbook assigned Marcus
RED-0099 | DataCraft | eu-west1, us-east1 | 64 (40 eu, 24 us) | 2026-12-01 | 20 (eu:12/us:8) | 24 (eu:14/us:10) | 20 (eu:14/us:6) | 78% | 15% (10 units) | Split regional allocation due to compliance, verify VPC peering
RED-0115 | RetailMax | ap-northeast1 | 24 | 2027-01-05 | 6 | 8 | 10 | 66% | 20% (5 units) | Sales to confirm holidays traffic spike assumption
RED-0148 | MediSys | us-east1 | 96 | 2026-11-01 | 32 | 32 | 32 | 85% | 8% (8 units) | Enterprise SLA - guaranteed throughput; pre-assign dedicated hosts
RED-0203 | EdgeVision | global (multi-region) | 12 | 2026-11-20 | 6 (us:3/eu:2/ap:1) | 4 | 2 | 55% | 0% | Lightweight; prefer burst over reserved
RED-0237 | FinLedger | us-west1 | 200 | 2026-12-15 | 60 | 80 | 60 | 88% | 10% (20 units) | High-risk concentration; propose phased carve-out across us-west1 zones

Heatmap legend (text):
- HIGH: concentration > 30% of region usable capacity in next 3 months (tag: RED)
- MED: 15-30% of capacity (tag: AMBER)
- LOW: <15% (tag: GREEN)

Regional pressure summary (next 90 days):
- us-west1: HIGH (FinLedger + AcmePay + spikes from internal batch jobs) => projected 58% of usable capacity occupied by reserved contracts; recommend soft-fence additional 30 units for emergency and schedule maintenance windows carefully.
- eu-west1: MED (DataCraft primary) => 34% of local pool reserved; recommend routing non-compliant burst traffic to us-east1 fallback where possible.
- us-east1: HIGH (MediSys guaranteed + DataCraft fallback) => 46% reserved; plan for cross-region KV cache warmup to reduce cold-start token penalty.
- ap-northeast1: LOW-to-MED => RetailMax ramp but small absolute numbers; monitor holiday week throughput.

Utilization projection methodology (short):
- Input: historical tokens/sec per-customer, model selection mix, average sequence length per request.
- Convert tokens/sec -> GPU equivalent by benchmarking recent A100-80GB throughput per model family.
- Add 15% buffer, then bucket across months using sales ramp plan.
- Contingency: max(conservative_percent, contract_burst_claim)

Risks & mitigations:
- Large single-region concentration (FinLedger) increases blast radius: mitigation = carve-out across zones, enable prioritized evictions only after cross-region failover tested (owner Priya).
- Underestimation of sequence length in holiday traffic: work with solutions engineering to collect sample prompts; if >20% deviation, escalate buffer to +30% for affected contracts.
- Interference from internal batch jobs: propose scheduled quiet window 0300-0500 UTC for us-west1 heavy jobs; engineering infra owners to schedule.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Sales confirmation on RetailMax holiday correctness (due 2026-11-07, Slack thread linked).
- Approve proposed 30-unit soft-fence in us-west1 for emergency capacity (SRE sign-off required).
- Decide whether FinLedger gets dedicated hosts (cost + operational impact).

Immediate next actions (owner tags):
- Sofia: finalize mapping to physical host pools and submit reservation change by 2026-11-06 (jira:INFRA-2345).
- Marcus: validate cross-region failover script and schedule dry-run in staging by 2026-11-10.
- Priya: coordinate with sales to lock ramp dates and confirm burst SLAs (sales ticket SALES-RED-92).

Appendix (quick calcs):
- Example conversion: 1 x Llama2-70b chat at 2048 seq on A100 equals ~0.85 units relative to baseline; batched throughput measured at 12 tokens/sec per unit.
- Month window totals (planned reserved units by month):
  Month0: 136 units reserved (after contingency 154)
  Month1-2: 166 units reserved (after contingency 189)
plain_text_preview: Per-customer bucketized phasing + heatmap (Nov 2026) - Draft sheet by Sofia Alvarez. Contains per-contract bucket allocations, heatmap summary, risks, and immediate actions.
